top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs bleed $635M as October slides back into the red
top_signals.summary: Thursday’s withdrawals ended a three-day inflow streak and left US spot Bitcoin ETFs with $175 million in net outflows for October.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Scam Victims Leave Gold in Forest in Growing Norwegian Fraud
top_signals.summary: Scammers in one of the world’s richest countries have a brazen new tactic: persuading people to hide gold in forests and other public places so it can be collected for safekeeping.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Denmark to buy Kongsberg, Covenant missiles for new long-range strike option
top_signals.summary: Copenhagen wants to acquire the capability to strike back at enemies attacking first, hoping for a deterrent effect.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: LiteLLM release pipeline hacked to distribute info-stealer malware
top_signals.summary: Hackers compromised the LiteLLM project's PyPI package and published malicious Docker images with a payload that steals credentials, secrets, and environment variables. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today's epic patch batch dwarfs September's record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Security researchers at Amazon Threat Intelligence say attackers began targeting the PHP2Shell flaws four days before security patches were released on Wednesday. [...]
